verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public LightSprint API, let alone one that matches the UI feature for feature. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt both returned 404. Task creation from Slack, Linear or Jira and outbound MCP connectors are adjacent integrations, not a programmatic API covering what the UI can do.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
